home.title: Yayatoh
home.tagline: Your events and tickets will appear here soon.

common.offline: You’re offline. Showing what is saved on this phone.
common.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.network: We couldn’t reach Yayatoh. Check your connection and try again.
common.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}} and try again.
common.rateLimitedNoTime: Too many tries. Wait a moment and try again.
common.verifyEmail: Verify your email address to use your tickets.
common.notFoundBody: It may have been transferred, refunded or removed from your account.

list.title: My tickets
list.refreshFailed: We couldn’t refresh your tickets. Showing what is saved on this phone.
list.offlineNothing: You’re offline and nothing is saved on this phone yet. Connect once to save your tickets for offline use.
list.emptyUpcomingBody: Tickets you buy or receive appear here, and stay on this phone for the door.
list.emptyPastBody: Tickets for events that are over appear here.
list.openTicket: Opens the ticket and its QR code

detail.title: Ticket
detail.qrHint: Show this code at the entrance. The screen stays at full brightness while this ticket is open.
detail.qrUnavailable: There is no code for this ticket.
detail.void: This ticket is no longer valid
detail.voidBody: It was refunded or cancelled and will not be accepted at the door.
detail.endedBody: The ticket is kept here for your records.
detail.offlineCopy: You’re offline. This is the copy saved on this phone.
detail.updateFailed: We couldn’t refresh this ticket. This is the copy saved on this phone.
detail.calendarDenied: Calendar access is off. You can turn it on for Yayatoh in your phone’s settings.
detail.directionsFailed: We couldn’t open a maps app.
detail.walletFailed: We couldn’t add this ticket to your wallet. Try again in a moment.
detail.walletUnavailable: This wallet isn’t available for this ticket.
detail.walletOffline: Connect to the internet to add this ticket to your wallet.
detail.transferPendingBody: Waiting for {name} to claim this ticket. It stays yours until they do.
detail.cancelTransferConfirm: Cancel the transfer to {name}? The link we emailed stops working.

transferRefused.ticket_void: This ticket can’t be transferred any more.
transferRefused.event_ended: This event is over, so the ticket can’t be transferred.

detail.transferUntil: You can transfer this ticket until {deadline}.

transfer.title: Transfer ticket
transfer.intro: Send this ticket to someone else. They get an email with a link to claim it. The ticket stays yours until they do, and then your code and wallet pass stop working.
transfer.emailIsYours: That is your own email address.
transfer.confirmBody: Transfer {ticket} to {name} ({email})? You can cancel until they claim it.
transfer.feeNotice: This ticket type charges a transfer fee of {fee}. You agree to it and pay it on the web.
transfer.webOpened: Finish the transfer on the web. When you come back, your tickets refresh.
transfer.sentBody: {name} will get an email at {email} with a link to claim the ticket. You can cancel the transfer until they do.
transfer.sameHolder: That person already holds this ticket.
transfer.invalidState: This transfer can’t be started any more.
transfer.alreadyPending: This ticket already has a transfer waiting.

refund.title: Refund request
refund.loadFailed: We couldn’t load the order for this ticket.
refund.policyNone: This order was bought with no refunds.
refund.policyUntilDays: Refunds can be requested up to {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} before the event.
refund.policyAlways: Refunds can be requested any time before the event.
refund.statusOpen: Waiting for the organizer. They have five business days to answer.

refusal.request_open: You already have a request waiting for an answer.
refusal.policy_no_refunds: This order doesn’t allow refund requests.
refusal.policy_window_closed: The window to ask for a refund has closed.

refund.sent: Request sent. The organizer has five business days to answer.
refund.noLonger: Refunds can’t be requested for this order any more.
refund.alreadyOpen: A request for this order is already waiting.

claim.title: Claim your ticket
claim.invalidBody: It may have expired or been mistyped. Ask the sender for a new link.
claim.signInTitle: Sign in to claim this ticket
claim.signInBody: Sign in with the email address the ticket was sent to. We’ll bring you back here.
claim.offerPlain: {organizer} has a ticket for you to {event}.
claim.name: Name on the ticket
claim.nameRequired: Enter the name for the ticket.
claim.successBody: {type} for {event} is now in your tickets.
claim.stateClaimed: This ticket has already been claimed
claim.stateClaimedBody: If you claimed it, it is in your tickets.
claim.stateRevokedBody: Ask them to send it again.
claim.stateExpiredBody: Ask the sender for a new link.
claim.mismatchTitle: This ticket was sent to a different email address
claim.mismatchBody: It was sent for {name}, and you are signed in as {email}. Sign in with the address the sender used to claim it.
claim.mismatchBodyPlain: You are signed in as {email}. Sign in with the address the sender used to claim it.
claim.failed: We couldn’t claim the ticket. Try again.
claim.unverified: Verify your email address before claiming a ticket.

link.title: Your ticket
link.signInTitle: Sign in to open your ticket
link.signInBody: Sign in with the email address the ticket was sent to. We’ll open it for you.
link.notFoundBody: The link may have expired, or the ticket belongs to a different email address. Your tickets are in the Tickets tab.
